decision_description: The live MSCA action targeted by this run is confirmed as MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships (PF) - action type HORIZON-TMA-MSCA-PF (European Fellowships EF / Global Fellowships GF) - and NOT MSCA Doctoral Networks (DN), Staff Exchanges (SE), COFUND, or COFUND Choose Europe (COFUND-CE). Basis: (1) the application form on disk (docs/tier2a_instrument_schemas/application_forms/msca/af_he-msca-pf_en.pdf and its Part B template 'Tpl_Application Form (Part B) (HE MSCA PF).rtf', version 5.0 of 27 March 2026) is titled 'Marie Sklodowska-Curie Actions - Postdoctoral Fellowships (HE MSCA PF)'; (2) the PF form structure is a researcher-at-a-host fellowship - a single postdoctoral researcher and a beneficiary host organisation (plus, for GF, an associated partner hosting the outgoing phase) - which matches the live MSCA-style project (crop water-stress monitoring, a single-researcher postdoctoral project) rather than the consortium / network / co-funding models of DN, SE, and COFUND; (3) the MSCA evaluation form's [OPTION for MSCA Postdoctoral fellowships] criterion aspects (supervision and two-way transfer of knowledge; researcher's professional experience; career perspectives of the researcher; host capacity and hosting arrangements) map exactly to the PF Part B template sub-sections 1.3, 1.4, 2.1, and 3.2. PF was the inferred action in D1 of the milestone decision record; this confirmation replaces that inference against the form (§10.6). The specific call binding (HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01) is recorded in Tier 3 selected_call.json and the Tier 2B PF call extract (ticket 6).
alternatives_considered: Doctoral Networks (DN) - rejected: DN funds consortium-based doctoral training networks recruiting PhD candidates, not a single postdoctoral researcher at a host. The DN evaluation aspects (training programme, joint supervision, consortium expertise) do not match the live project.
Staff Exchanges (SE) - rejected: SE funds secondment-based exchanges of staff between participating organisations to build collaborations, not a hosted postdoctoral fellowship.

COFUND / COFUND Choose Europe (COFUND-CE) - rejected: COFUND co-funds regional/national/international fellowship programmes (a recruitment/selection programme run by an institution), not a single research project. The COFUND evaluation aspects (selection/recruitment process, appointment conditions) do not match.

Leaving PF as an unconfirmed inference - rejected: CLAUDE.md §10.6 requires reading the form when present rather than relying on prior knowledge or inference; the PF form and evaluation form are present and directly confirm the action.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §10.6 (source documents govern; generic programme knowledge is a fallback of last resort and must be flagged); Tier 2A docs/tier2a_instrument_schemas/application_forms/msca/Tpl_Application Form (Part B) (HE MSCA PF).rtf (form title and Part B structure); Tier 2A docs/tier2a_instrument_schemas/evaluation_forms/msca/ef_he-msca_en.pdf V.2.2 (PF-specific criterion aspects); MILESTONE1_DECISION_RECORD.md D1 (PF is the inferred action - confirm against the form in Stage 2).
rationale: Stage 2 requires the actual MSCA action to be confirmed against the form before extraction, not assumed (D1, brief §1.4, §10.6). The form title, the researcher-at-a-host structure, and the exact correspondence between the PF-specific evaluation-form aspects and the PF Part B sub-sections jointly confirm PF over the four alternative MSCA actions. This determination is recorded durably per CLAUDE.md §9.4 / §13.5 so the instrument extraction in section_schema_registry.json, instrument_registry.json, and evaluator_expectation_registry.json (all carrying instrument_type 'MSCA-PF') is traceable to a confirmed action rather than an inference.
